bundle.shortDescription: Read the land and the heavens.
bundle.longDescription: Aether is a geomancy engine — a local-first map of Earth's sacred, ancient, and anomalous places, a synthesized planetary grid, and an autonomous Loom that seeks alignments and nexus points while judging every one against chance. Every layer is kept; every layer is labeled by provenance. Toward Tesla's vision of global resonance.
